rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose choice for a person or thing judged morally good.

example.english: They are really ethical to hand in the wallet they found to the police.
example.traditional: 佢連拾到人哋銀包都交返畀警察，真係有道德。
example.jyutping: keoi5 lin4 sap6 dou3 jan4 dei6 ngan4 baau1 dou1 gaau1 faan2 bei2 ging2 caat3 zan1 hai6 jau5 dou6 dak1

rows.note: Use this noun attributively in compounds about ethical principles, guidelines, issues, or conduct.

example.english: The company needs to set clear ethical guidelines so employees know what to do.
example.traditional: 公司要先訂清楚道德指引，員工先知點做。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 jiu3 sin1 ding3 cing1 co2 dou6 dak1 zi2 jan5 jyun4 gung1 sin1 zi1 dim2 zou6

rows.note: Use this especially for an action, decision, or course of action that meets moral standards.

example.english: Although this decision isn't easy, I think it is ethical.
example.traditional: 呢個決定雖然唔容易，但我覺得係合乎道德嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 seoi1 jin4 m4 jung4 ji6 daan6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 hai6 hap6 fu4 dou6 dak1 ge3
